description: Defines classes and functions for managing budgets, budget lines, and budget-related operations in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including budget creation, confirmation, validation, cancellation, and calculations of planned, practical, and theoretical amounts.

classes.name: account_budget_post
classes.description: Represents a budgetary position with associated dotations and budget lines, including a method to spread amounts over fiscal periods.

classes.name: account_budget_post_dotation
classes.description: Represents budget dotations linked to budget posts, with a function to compute total planned amounts within a period.

classes.name: crossovered_budget
classes.description: Represents a budget with start/end dates, status, responsible users, and associated budget lines, including methods to change state.

classes.name: crossovered_budget_lines
classes.description: Represents individual budget line items with calculations for practical, theoretical amounts, and percentage of budget used.

classes.name: account_analytic_account
classes.description: Extends analytic accounts to include associated budget lines.

methods.name: spread
methods.description: Distributes a total amount over the periods of a fiscal year for a given budget post.

methods.name: _tot_planned
methods.description: Calculates total planned amount for a budget post dotation within a specific period.

methods.name: budget_validate
methods.description: Validates the budget, setting its state to 'validate' and recording the validator.

methods.name: budget_cancel
methods.description: Cancels the budget, setting its state to 'cancel'.

methods.name: _prac_amt
methods.description: Calculates practical amount spent within a date range for a budget line.

methods.name: _prac
methods.description: Returns practical amount for a budget line.

methods.name: _theo_amt
methods.description: Calculates the theoretical amount for a budget line based on elapsed time.

methods.name: _theo
methods.description: Returns the theoretical amount for a budget line.

methods.name: _perc
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of practical amount relative to the theoretical amount.
